rule_or_pattern: drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out (cpp_vs_book < 0.5: label is a short fragment, the crop a full different line). Secondary relabel: the ordinal β read as digit 6 in grammatical abbreviations, regex `(ἀορ|παρκ|μελ|ὑπερσ)\. 6\.` -> `$1. β.`
notes: An 1888 school handbook of irregular verbs, with dense abbreviations and paradigms; the punctuation and OOV flags are genre, and most lines read correctly (2-8, 10, 11, 13, 15-20, 27, 29-31, 34-40). Five lines are crop/label mismatches with cpp_vs_book of about 0.3. In 22 the crop shows '...κέκριμαι, ὑπερσ. ἐκεκρίμην, π. ἀορ. ἐκρίθην...' but the label is 'μ.. μελ. ἀντὶ παθ.', and 23, 25, 26 and 28 are similar. The ordinal 'β.' is read as '6.' in 'ἀορ. 6.' in lines 1 and 24, though 12 has 'ἀορ. β.' correctly.
